title: Asset provenance record
description: One PROVENANCE.json per asset directory. Every file in the directory must be listed. Validated by scripts/validate.mjs (hash, dimensions, required fields, licence).

model.description: Model or software agent as exposed by the tool or by credentials embedded in the files

contentCredentials.description: Provenance embedded in the files themselves (for example a C2PA manifest): standard, software agent, claim generator, actions and signer as read from the file

operator.description: A role label (for example 'design-system maintainer'), never a personal name

license.description: Licence statement for the files in the directory; required and checked by the validator

postProcessing.description: Edits after generation, or a statement that there were none, including delivered versus requested dimensions

path.description: Relative to the directory of the PROVENANCE.json

dimensions.description: Required for raster files; checked against the file header

brief.description: Brief identifier from imagery/briefs.md, for example IB-02

reconstructed.description: Reserved. The repository ships no reconstruction of a mark under any label (decisions 0007 and 0010); the validator rejects an entry that sets this to true
